page.overview:
Who is Akataa?

Akataa joined the protectors' ranks at an early point in their life and trained in accordance to the group's traditions. Over the course of the Hundred Year War, however, it had become normal for Jasmine Island protectors to ultimately leave their home to fight as volunteers against the Fire Nation. As a result, Akataa's older trainers also left, passing the responsibility of training and commanding the remaining, younger protectors to Akataa.

Over time, Akataa became one of the most experienced warriors on the island. and together worked out a plan to stop Yueya. This culminated in a battle where Akataa and their friends defeated the admiral, helping to save their home.

Akataa was a warm and friendly person, making it occasionally difficult for them to make hard and assertive choices as a leader. When they overcame their doubts, however, Akataa was an inspiring and diplomatic person who was well suited to bear both the burdens as well as triumphs of leadership.

Besides their substantial leadership talent, Akataa was also a highly skilled nonbending martial artist. Their fighting style was based on Jasmine Island's traditional combat techniques and consisted of dance- or flow-like strikes and parries using a staff with weighted baskets on either end.
